# Code of Conduct

## Our pledge

We pledge to make participation in this project a harassment-free experience for
everyone, regardless of age, body size, visible or invisible disability,
ethnicity, sex characteristics, gender identity and expression, level of
experience, education, socio-economic status, nationality, personal appearance,
race, religion, or sexual identity and orientation.

## Our standards

Examples of behaviour that contributes to a positive environment:

* Being kind and patient with people who are new to voice AI
* Giving and gracefully accepting constructive feedback
* Respecting differing opinions and experiences
* Focusing on what is best for the community

Examples of unacceptable behaviour: harassment, insulting or derogatory comments,
personal or political attacks, publishing others' private information, and
unwelcome sexual attention.

## A note specific to this project

Voice cloning is powerful technology. Please clone only voices you have the
right to clone, and do not use this project to deceive anyone. The default
speech model is CC-BY-NC and is not cleared for commercial resale.

## Enforcement

Report unacceptable behaviour by opening a report through GitHub's
[private reporting](https://docs.github.com/en/communities/maintaining-your-safety-on-github/reporting-abuse-or-spam).
Reports are handled confidentially.

This Code of Conduct is adapted from the
[Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/), version 2.1.
